about: First-person camera for Mafia III from the game's own camera configs (tables.sds).
The camera sits at the look point: actor + OffsetLook.OffsetActor + OffsetLook.OffsetCamera (camera axes:
x right, z up, y BACK toward the viewer: +0.2 put the camera behind the head, 2026-10-20 screenshot) - DistanceCurve
x view. Distance 0 puts it at the look point; y = -0.3 puts it 0.3 m ahead of the body axis along the view, about
18 cm in front of the eyes, so the head is never in view. In a 7-character field -0.3 is written "-.3" (so steps
of 0.1 m only: "-.25" does not fit).
Cover, melee, takedowns, ladders, swimming, death and vehicles keep the game's third-person cameras.
Values are text inside the archive: each new value is written with the old text length (see build_fp_camera.py).
tested_sha16: the tables.sds (first 16 hex of SHA-256) the rules were built and played on; another one only gets a
line in the report: the values are found by name and checked after writing. Add a clean Steam copy once tried.

rules.note: these curves have one character for the distance: the points are written anew ("-2 .02" ...); with one distance everywhere their pitch positions do not matter, they only stay in order

on foot: 2 cm of orbit distance at any pitch, so the camera sits 0.28 m ahead (0.38 / 0.48 on the move): asked 2 cm closer (2026-10-20); the 7-character offset fields only take steps of 0.1
no shoulder offset, 0.3 m ahead along the view (y points back); 0.2 felt a little inside the head
walking leans the head forward: at 0.2 the eyes and mouth came into view (2026-10-20)
sprinting leans it further
eye height standing; the same with a gun out (the combat stance had 1.7 outdoors: the camera dipped 8 cm when a gun was drawn, 2026-10-21); a 7-character field takes it as 1.8
behind a mounted gun
collision start point at the eyes instead of above the head

spring between the game's 0.075 (left the camera 0.4 m behind on the run) and 0.025 (followed every jolt of the body, felt sharp, 2026-10-21); it trails by about speed x time (0.18 m jogging), the 0.2 m near clip keeps the head out; 0.001 showed every step as a jerk; never 0, a spring divides by it
transition 12 is '*.idle.running' -> '*.idle.standing' in all three player cameras: 0.25 -> 0.5 s, so stopping does not pull the camera 10 cm back at once (2026-10-21)

transition 10 is '*.idle.standing' -> '*.idle.running' in all three player cameras: 0.5 -> 0.2 -> 0.1 s. Starting off, the spring trails the body more with every step (speed x 0.045 s) and the head leans forward, while the camera took half a second from the standing 0.28 m ahead to the walking 0.38: for a moment it was behind the eyes and the eyes and mouth showed (2026-10-21). At 0.2 s it still fell up to 0.17 m behind starting off sharply (2026-10-22 log); the trainer hides the body for such a moment, a quicker move makes it rarer. The field holds three characters ('0.5'): 0.12 does not fit
transition 11 is '*.idle.standing' -> '*.idle.sprinting': 0.5 -> 0.3 -> 0.2 s for the same reason (0.28 -> 0.48 m); a little slower than walking off, so the 20 cm forward does not jump
the camera never swings behind the walking direction by itself
